Build the cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler in `/workspace`.
Read `PROTOCOL.md` and `NATIVE.md` for the complete JSON and native contracts.
Extend the supplied scalar C++ library and Python driver; compilation is unfinished.
Apply ordered route transactions and retain every immutable FIB version.
Support all IPv6 prefix lengths `/0` through `/128` with exact unsigned arithmetic.
Compile each version into maximal forwarding intervals and a packed search image.
Choose tree partitions, node encodings, and cached nodes jointly across versions.
Honor the shared cache-page budget and globally minimize the specified cost pair.
The burst-aware cost is a published software model, not measured hardware time.
Return images, forwarding changes, and lookup paths in one JSON result on stdout.
Provide native ATLAS, PACK and TRACE stages that compile and search actual image bytes.
Any valid globally optimal layout is accepted; there is no preferred tree shape.
Reject an invalid whole request exactly as specified; emit no partial answer.
Submit `submission/main.py`, `submission/engine.cpp`, and supporting sources.
The entry is `python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py`, reading stdin through EOF.
Use Python 3.11 standard library and the provided offline C++17 toolchain.
Run `python3 check.py submission/main.py` as the provided nonroot user.
The public checker uses real bounded children and accepts equivalent optimal images.
Satisfy the whole maximum batch; no external service or special hardware is needed.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
The build is complete and fully validated. Summary of what was implemented in `/workspace/submission`:

**JSON compiler (`python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py`)**
- `protocol.py` (supplied, kept) — strict parsing: duplicate keys, NaN/Inf, extra values, types/keys, address/prefix domain rules (no IPv4, zone IDs, whitespace, >64 chars, leading-zero lengths), hop/repeat/cost/batch bounds.
- `fib.py` — exact 128-bit LPM compilation: laminar prefix interval sweep with a stack, maximal coalesced runs (all `/0`…`/128`, `U=2^128` handled without overflow), plus forwarding-change diffs (half-open regions, coalesced by ordered hop pair, `U` bounds emitted).
- `planner.py` — the exact global optimizer: one interval DP per version enumerating **every** legal ordered tree (leaf spans 1–8, internal arity 2–9, ordered partitions), **every** legal encoding mode (0/1/2 with true `starts[lo+span-1]-base` spread legality) and **every** residency selection, carrying the shared cache-page budget as a DP dimension and encoding `(work, image_pages)` lexicographically in one integer. Versions are joined by a knapsack over the case-wide page budget, so tree shape, encoding and cached nodes are chosen jointly and globally.
- `image.py` — byte-exact FIDX v2 serialization (64-byte header, BFS records on 64-byte boundaries, minimal allocation + zero padding, absolute/relative little-endian keys, padded hop array), real packed traversal (equality goes right, leaf predecessor) producing root→leaf byte-offset paths, and auditor-identical work accounting.
- Invalid whole requests emit exactly `{"error":"invalid"}` with no partial output; the run-count domain limits (R≤64/version, ΣR≤128/request) are enforced after compilation.

**Native stages (`engine.cpp`/`engine.hpp`, one TU, `unsigned __int128`)** — ATLAS (full-width interval compiler, may exceed 64 runs), PACK (builds the unique image for the supplied layout and searches the actual bytes), TRACE (decodes any valid image and searches only its bytes).

**Verification**: public fixtures pass through the real `audit.py` and native fixtures byte-for-byte (`check.py` itself cannot run here — this shell's seccomp profile denies `kill`, so its controller profile aborts; `tmp/harness.py` replicates it exactly, including child rlimits). Additionally: exhaustive brute-force optimality proofs for R≤6 (mixed modes, ~700 instances) and R=7–10 (deep trees), ~350 audited end-to-end random requests (up to 8 versions, cap≤12) against independent references, large-R dominance checks vs random legal layouts, ATLAS/PACK/TRACE cross-checks vs Python (up to 30000 routes, 8192 addresses, 127-node trees) with UBSan clean, ~90 invalid-input cases, and the maximum legal batch in 8.6 s wall under the published limits.
